name: Guandan
summary: Four-player team shedding ladder game from Jiangsu where teams race from level 2 to Ace.
rules_text: Four players in two fixed partnerships, using 108 cards (two decks + 4 jokers). Each gets 27 cards. Each hand has a level card = level of last hand's winning team. Hearts of that rank are wild except as singletons, and all level cards rank above Ace. A trick: leader plays any legal set: single, pair, triple, 2 consecutive triples (plate), 3 consecutive pairs (tube), full house, 5-card straight. Others must pass or beat with same type or throw a bomb. Bombs in ascending strength: 4-5 of a kind, straight flush, 6+ of a kind, 4 jokers. First to empty hand is Banker, his team wins hand and levels up 1-3 levels depending if partner is third, second or last. Dweller (last) leads next hand and must tribute highest card to Banker for any <=10, unless holding both red jokers. First team to win a hand after reaching Ace level wins the match.
